title: Should NFL mandate early travel for Week 1 international games?

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Should NFL mandate early travel for Week 1 international games?
sources.description: As the conversation continues on the Rams' apparent misfire regarding the decision to barnstorm into and out of Melbourne, there's another question that needs to be asked about Week 1 international games played a long way away from the U.S.
